mapper.select: SELECT u.username AS name, u.user_profile_url AS profileUrl, tp.career AS description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e JOIN trainings t2 ON e.training_id = t2.training_id WHERE t2.trainer_id = #{trainerId}) AS traineeCount, tp.total_average_rating AS averageRating, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trainer_certificates tc WHERE tc.trainer_id = tp.trainer_id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isCertified FROM users u JOIN trainer_profiles tp ON u.user_id = tp.trainer_id WHERE tp.trainer_id = #{trainerId}
SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.title AS title, t.level AS level, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl FROM trainings t WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId}
